title: Mid-Block Pedestrian Hybrid Beacon (HAWK) & Rapid-Flashing Crosswalk Stop

no_head_on_same_lane.note: All foreground vehicles seen from rear face forward same direction; no opposing vehicles share a lane.

no_rhd_cabin.note: No vehicle interior or steering wheel is visible; only exterior rear views.

single_bulb_signal.note: Overhead beacon shows two simultaneously lit red upper lenses, violating at-most-one-lit-lens rule.

us_right_hand_traffic.note: Vehicles stopped on right side of road, double-yellow center on left, white lane/edge markings on right, consistent with US right-hand traffic.

zero_text.note: All signs, beacons, and plates are blank shapes; no letters, numbers, or words visible.

scene_match.note: Shows overhead HAWK with two reds, side yellow flashers, crosswalk, stopped SUV/sedan, and family crossing as prompted.

result.summary: Scene matches HAWK description and teaches stopping, but overhead signal has two red lenses lit at once, failing single-bulb rule, so REJECT.

teaching_correct.note: Vehicles stopped for red beacon while family uses crosswalk teaches correct stop-behind-line behavior; no opposite priority shown.

result.what_i_see: A family of four crosses a mid-block white crosswalk viewed from behind, with a silver SUV and dark sedan stopped on the right and an overhead gantry showing two lit red lights above yellow roadside flashers.
